newsitem.title: PERU: Peru July molybdenum output falls 36.2 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru July molybdenum output falls 36.2 percent.

text.p: Peru's molybdenum output fell 36.2 percent to 203 tonnes in July, compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary figures from the Energy and Mines Ministry released Thursday.
Production fell 5.4 percent to 1,768 tonnes in the first seven months of the year compared with the same period last year, the ministry said.
Molybdenum output rose 19.5 percent to 3,411 tonnes in 1995 compared with 2,854 tonnes during the previous year.
U.S.-based Southern Peru Ltd is Peru's main producer of molybdenum.
